name: Ink Bleed Text
description: Words that appear the way ink spreads into wet paper: each starts as a soft blot and tightens into crisp letters.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Each word is its own element and stays real, selectable text.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between one word landing and the next.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each word takes to tighten from a blot into letters. Its rim darkens as the ink soaks in, then evens out.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the text scrolls into view. Set false to start on mount. To play it again, remount it with a new key.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render, such as "h1" or "p".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the element; the ink is the text colour. Other props are passed through. Under reduced motion the words fade in without the blot.
